maya: FYI we're piloting a 'mini-play' for SI onboarding next month: 1-day fast path to get SIs to first listing + verification. Need a super short ops checklist, a 20-min lab, and a one-click voucher flow. Who picks these up?

samir: I can do the ops checklist + voucher flow. Will keep it to 6 bullet items: creds, CIDR, KMS role, ECR write, quota ticket link, contact.

nora: I'll design the 20-min lab: repo clone, deploy model, confirm inference, teardown. Keep it reproducible in 30m.

kai: I'll do a tiny verification script (curl + latency assert) and a 3-slide cheat sheet for partners.

partners-bot: Created event "SI mini-play kickoff" Thu 10:00 PT.

maya: Constraints: ephemeral tokens only, no prod keys, partners must confirm support window. Target: time-to-first-listing < 90 minutes.

samir: Will post voucher codes and ops one-pager by Tue.

nora: Draft lab steps will be in a gist by Wed.

kai: Slides + script by Wed EOD.

maya: Nice. Action items captured. We'll run a dry-run next Fri. :rocket:
